messages:
meena: Quick heads-up — Aurora private rollout: customer asking to move cutover up by 24h. Can we do a short preflight tomorrow 10:00am PST? Need network + ops owners for smoke tests and firewall thumbs.

anil: I can own egress smoke tests. Which endpoints should I validate? registry + package mirror + S3 mirror?

sara: Yes. Registry (registry.redwood-infra.internal, 10.12.0.5), package mirror (10.12.0.6), s3 mirror 34.120.55.99. Only outbound 443/80 to those. SSH (22) only from jumpbox range 10.8.0.0/24. :thumbsup:

luke: I put up infra PR for registry fallback if mirror is down: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/982 — needs review @carol. That adds image pull retry + local cache policy.

carol: Ack, will review this evening. FYI the airgap package sync is currently failing because the customer mirror has an incomplete CA chain. Meena, can you check with their infra contact (Ash) to get the full cert bundle?

meena: Already on it, emailed Ash and copied their netops. They might provision the missing intermediate by EOD. If not, we'll run a temporary sidecar to rewrite certs during mirror sync.

netops-bot: Reminder: preflight egress checklist must be green before canary. Items: OPEN_PORTS(443,80), SSH_RESTRICTED(22 from 10.8.0.0/24), DNS_RESOLVE(registry.* -> 10.12.0.5), NTP_SYNC(yes), PROXY_CONFIGURED(if airgapped).

anil: For smoke tests, I'll run these quick checks (planning commands below):
```
# resolve registry
dig +short registry.redwood-infra.internal @10.0.0.2
# curl registry catalog via host override
curl -v --resolve registry.redwood-infra.internal:443:10.12.0.5 https://registry.redwood-infra.internal/v2/_catalog
# attempt pull from k8s node
kubectl --context aurora-staging run -it --rm image-test --image=alpine --restart=Never -- sh -c "apk add --no-cache curl; curl -I https://registry.redwood-infra.internal/v2/"
```

meena: Perfect. Can you drop results in this thread once done? Also need a quick validation that KV cache sync to HSM isn't blocked — deploy-bot will attempt key unwrap during canary.

deploy-bot: Canary window scheduled: 2024-06-12T18:00:00Z. Canary steps: 1) image pull smoke, 2) registry fallback enabled, 3) small traffic shift 5%, 4) monitor errors. Auto-rollback on >=1% 5xxs over 5m.

sara: One more network ask: customer uses NAT for egress; ensure we provide guidance to map ephemeral SNAT pools so we can whitelist on their side. I posted a short doc in the customer ticket.

luke: FYI there is one known dependency: the mirror sync job needs outbound access to packages.redwood-artifacts (port 443) and to apt repo mirrors (archive.ubuntu.com). If airgapped without egress to those, we need a preseed tarball — @meena can coordinate.

meena: I'll prepare preseed if Ash confirms no internet. Target: preseed package tar + image bundle by 08:00am PST tomorrow.

carol: Reviewed infra PR quickly — small nits, mostly logging. Will approve once tests pass. Then we can flip the fallback flag in config for the canary.

anil: Running smoke tests now, will post timestamps/responses.

(10m later)
anil: Results: dig -> 10.12.0.5, curl registry catalog 200 OK, kubectl image pull success. NTP sync OK. No issues from my side. Logs attached: registry responded with 200, small latency spike ~120ms during TLS handshake.

meena: Great, thanks. Carol, once PR merges, can we tag the canary and get the deploy window confirmed?

carol: Merged and tagged v2024.06-canary. deploy-bot, kick the canary when ready.

deploy-bot: Canary started (2024-06-12T18:00:00Z). Step 1 complete: image pulls succeeded for 100% of canary pods. Rolling traffic 5%. Monitoring dashboards: no errors in first 2m.

sara: Heads-up: customer reported intermittent packet drops on their side during a test earlier — they are routing through a new firewall cluster. Ash said they will correlate with NAT pool mapping. Keep an eye on 5xxs.

anil: Noted. I'll keep smoke scripts running in a loop for the next 30m and post if we hit anything.

meena: Thanks everyone. I'll follow up with Ash on cert bundle and preseed final. If any owner can't make the 10am PST preflight, call it out here. Otherwise I think we're green to proceed. :shipit:
